name: Expanding Brain
look: Four rows with blank text boxes on the left and brain images on the right that grow brighter each step: a small dim brain in an X-ray skull, a brain with glowing sparks, a brain blazing with white light, and a radiant blue head shooting rays of light.
use: Each row holds an idea, ranked from ordinary at the top to supposedly enlightened at the bottom, though the lower ideas are usually the most absurd, ironic or overthought takes.
slots: the most absurd enlightened idea (bottom row)
examples: Putting the phone across the room
Never sleeping so you can't oversleep
Saying catch you on the flip side
Slowly backing out of the room in silence
describe: brain getting bigger and glowing brighter in each row
four levels of brains lighting up more and more
small brain to cosmic glowing brain chart
x-ray head with a brain that starts shining with light
escalating enlightenment with a head beaming light rays
